cadence: Monthly, confirmed by user; exact monthly deadlines require agreement.
source: Structural review of user-supplied appraisal archive; original files and any personal information remain private. Archive includes nested variants, so the approved master/version must be selected internally.
steps: Select the approved role-specific form and record employee, actual review month and confirmed direct reviewer privately. Do not infer a reviewer from coordination responsibilities.
Collect month-specific evidence from tasks, quality/revision records, outputs and role-appropriate results. Distinguish missing inputs or changed scope from individual execution.
Employee completes Self-Rating before the review meeting. Manager completes Manager Rating; compare the gap rather than assuming agreement.
Use the supplied 1–5 scale and behavioral anchors. Ratings 1, 2 and 5 require a brief evidence-based justification in the Notes field/section.

Check the role-specific weights and calculations. Supplied Excel uses Gap = Manager minus Self and weighted contribution = KPI weight × Manager Rating / 5. Confirm completion before interpreting totals: blank manager ratings are treated as zero in the supplied formulas.

Hold the monthly review conversation, record achievements, blockers, strengths, improvement areas and employee feedback. Track the template's quarterly OKRs within the monthly conversation; do not confuse the two cadences.
Agree SMART goals and development/training actions for the next period, with accountable action owners and agreed follow-up. Record the signatures/decisions required by the adopted process.

Keep completed appraisals and salary/career information in private authorized storage; carry goals into the following monthly review. Promotion, salary, succession and HR fields are not automatic decisions or approvals.
open_decisions: Approved master/version; mapping nine supplied role-title families to the 14 positions (including missing/combined-role cases); reviewer of Marketing Manager; final HR/owner authority; exact deadlines and private storage/access. Do not create extra staff positions or force mismatched scorecards.
